TitlePage.Title: nofoma
TitlePage.Subtitle: Normal forms of matrices

Meinolf Geck
Fachbereich Mathematik, Pfaffenwaldring 57, 70569 Stuttgart, Germany

TitlePage.Abstract:
This package computes the Frobenius normal form and the Jordan-Chevalley decomposition of a (square) matrix over any field that is available in GAP. It also computes the Jordan normal form of matrices over finite fields.
Bug reports, suggestions and comments are, welcome. Please submit them to our issue tracker https://github.com/gap-packages/nofoma/issues.
